name: Guardrails AI
summary: Open-source Python framework for adding input/output guardrails (validators) to LLM applications.
description: Guards chain validators over LLM inputs and outputs. Guardrails Hub's `guardrails hub install`, the private validator registry and hosted remote inference were shut down on 2026-08-25; validators are now plain PyPI packages (`pip install guardrails-ai-<name>`, imported from `guardrails_ai.<name>`), and models run locally (use_local=True) or on your own endpoint. Anonymous metrics are on by default (enable_metrics defaults to true); opt out with `guardrails configure --disable-metrics` or Guard(...).configure(allow_metrics_collection=False). PyPI `guardrails-ai` 0.11.0.
